projectDescription: A curated collection of starter workflow templates that help developers quickly set up CI, deployment, automation, code scanning, and Pages workflows with GitHub Actions.
keyFeatures: 50+ CI workflow templates covering languages like Python, Node.js, Go, Java, Rust, Ruby, and more
30+ deployment workflow templates for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and other platforms
80+ code scanning templates integrating security tools like CodeQL, Snyk, SonarCloud, and Semgrep
Automation workflow templates for issue management, stale PR handling, and repository maintenance
Pages workflow templates for static site generators including Jekyll, Hugo, Next.js, Gatsby, and Astro
Preview/staging support via labels in properties.json
Structured properties.json metadata schema with name, description, iconName, categories, and creator fields
publicApiSurface: code-scanning/*.yml — Security and code scanning workflow templates
pages/*.yml — GitHub Pages deployment workflow templates
*/properties/*.properties.json — Workflow metadata and UI display configuration
icons/*.svg — SVG icons for workflow template display
$default-branch — Template variable substituted with repo default branch
$protected-branches — Template variable substituted with protected branches
$cron-daily — Template variable substituted with a random daily cron time
